version.changelog:
- Minor update with documentation cleanup in SKILL.md; removed redundant details in API usage sections for clarity.
- Example in examples/03-connected-mode.md was updated to better illustrate the connected mode flow.
- skill-card.md file was removed as part of documentation streamlining.
- No changes to local or connected mode behavior; functionality remains the same.

llm.summary: This is a coherent deck-generation skill, with the main user consideration being that connected mode sends the deck request to OnePress when an API key is configured.

dimensions.detail: Local mode writes an HTML file in the working directory and may load ECharts/Google Fonts; connected mode makes authenticated requests to OnePress. These are purpose-aligned and disclosed, but users should treat connected mode as external processing.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is documented as a standard ClawHub install or manual skills-folder placement; the package contains Markdown instructions and no executable scripts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill has clear deck-related activation guidance and explicit do-not-trigger cases, though connected mode is selected automatically when ONEPRESS_API_KEY is present.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No local persistence, privilege escalation, service installation, or tool hijacking was found. Connected mode uses an environment or MCP API key and a persistent OnePress workspace/memory, which is disclosed as part of the service behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The capabilities match the stated purpose: local mode creates a self-contained HTML slide deck, and connected mode uses OnePress APIs for research, export, images, and related deck pipeline features.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to create slide-deck artifacts. Without ONEPRESS_API_KEY it creates a local HTML file; with the key set, your deck prompt and related task content are sent to OnePress and may remain in that workspace for follow-up edits, so avoid connected mode for confidential material unless that external processing is acceptable.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The README example is broad, but the skill itself scopes use to slide decks and excludes summaries, code tasks, and spreadsheets, so this is not a standalone Review concern.
[SQP-2] expected: External submission in connected mode is real and purpose-aligned: the artifacts say the skill submits the task to OnePress and delegates to OnePress infrastructure. A clearer privacy notice would help, but the behavior is not hidden.
[EA2] unexpected: The cited text is credential-handling guidance telling the agent not to ask users to paste API keys into chat; it does not support a finding of destructive or high-impact autonomous action.
[SQP-3] expected: The fixed html lang example is a localization quality issue, not a security concern.
[SQP-2] expected: Creating a local .html file is the core local-mode deliverable and is disclosed in README, SKILL.md, and LOCAL-RECIPE.md.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The supplied SARIF run reported no T01-T09 security results, consistent with the inspected Markdown-only artifact.
